\xrlabel{tab:E-functionals}{{23.1}{}{Lattice constants and band gaps of silicon, germanium and gallium arsenide for three functionals, without spin--orbit coupling. Lattice constants from LDA and PBE are from Ref.~\cite [Table~II]{csonka2009assessing}, those from HSE from Ref.~\cite [Table~I]{lucero2012improved}. Gaps are evaluated at each functional's own relaxed lattice constant, from Ref.~\cite [Table~I]{lucero2012improved}; a zero gap means that the functional makes the crystal a metal. The static-lattice constants are the measured ones extrapolated to zero temperature with the zero-point anharmonic expansion removed~\cite [Table~II]{csonka2009assessing}; they are not measured at any temperature, and they lie below the lattice constants measured at low temperature. They are used only inside calculations, as the cell of a static lattice. The room-temperature lattice constants are measured: silicon~\cite [lattice parameter of silicon]{mohr2025codata}, germanium~\cite [Sect.~II\,A]{rideau2006strained} and GaAs~\cite {vurgaftman2001band}; they are the values for observables and the cell of the shared lattice setting of \cref {app:E.17}. The measured gaps are low-temperature values~\cite [Table~I]{lucero2012improved}}{Doc-Start}{}}
